name: mexihat
setup: [psi8, x8] = mexihat(-5, 5, 8); [psi16, x16] = mexihat(-5, 5, 16); [psi64, x64] = mexihat(-5, 5, 64); [psi_a, x_a] = mexihat(0, 5, 16);
comment: Sig: [psi, x] = mexihat(LB, UB, N). Mexican-hat wavelet ψ(t) = (2/√3)·π^(-1/4)·(1-t²)·exp(-t²/2). Even, peaks at 0, zeros at ±1. Coverage: N ∈ {8, 16, 64} on [-5, 5] + asymmetric range [0, 5].
